# Tavryz Studio

Tavryz is a premium software engineering, design, and growth marketing studio. We build high-performance web platforms, robust native Android applications, scalable design systems, and AI systems for technology leaders who demand structural integrity and data density.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI & Machine Learning Engineering**: Agents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Automation, Predictive Models
- **Web App Development**: Frontend, Backend, SaaS, Full-Stack Architecture
- **Mobile App Development**: iOS, Android, Cross-Platform solutions
- **Cybersecurity & Compliance**: Security Audits, Data Protection, Penetration Testing
- **UI/UX & Product Design**: Wireframing, Mobile/Web Design, User Research, Generative UI
- **Digital Marketing & SEO**: Social Media Marketing, Content Strategy, On-Page/Off-Page SEO, Growth Marketing

## Selected Case Studies
- **Aroush Works**: B2B manufacturing e-commerce platform. Increased conversion by 140%.
- **ICCS Global**: Enterprise logistics and supply chain portal. Reduced processing time by 60%.
- **Z Nectar**: Direct-to-consumer health brand storefront. Improved mobile sales by 210%.
